subject: Renewal roadmap demo — daypart coverage and backup hosts
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@brightcare.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightCare IT Team <it@brightcare.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap demo — daypart coverage and backup hosts

Thanks, Soojin — we’re excited to see the new roadmap and how Redwood might help with predictable daytime load.

A few constraints from our side:
- Primary stakeholders available 11/8 or 11/9 in the morning Pacific only (08:00–11:30 PT).
- We need at least one technical deep-dive for our infra folks (30–45 minutes).
- Legal asked to see the data retention slide briefly.

Can you propose a slot and confirm an internal backfill if one of our leads gets pulled into exec meetings?

Best,
Elena
Director, Platform Delivery
BrightCare Health
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@brightcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T13:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap demo — daypart coverage and backup hosts

Thanks for the constraints, Elena — that helps. Proposed approach:

1) 11/08 09:30–10:45 PT: 75-minute session split into 30m roadmap + 30m infra deep-dive + 15m next steps.
2) Backup hosts: we’ll include two Redwood engineers as stand-ins in case one of your leads is pulled — they can handle the infra Q&A and run a short verification demo.
3) We’ll include a brief legal-facing appendix on retention (5 minutes) and attach the runbook and agenda.

I’ve attached a tentative runbook and an .ics for the proposed slot. If that looks good, I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in our solutions engineer for the deep-dive.

— Soojin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
- proposed-agenda.ics (Calendar invite stub)

- Roadmap owners: Soojin (product overview) and Vivek (performance/cost controls).
- Infra deep-dive: Rishi (live session) with Marissa as ops lead for post-demo next steps.
- Legal retention appendix: included at minute 60; Elena — let us know if you want additional wording.
